projects.title: Layer
projects.description: Tree-sitter AST code navigation, static call-graph analysis, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI coding agents.
projects.fullDescription:
Why Layer

If you use coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex or OpenCode on real projects, you have probably seen these problems:

1. The agent can't see the big picture. On a repo with thousands of files, agents fall back to grep and dump whole files into the prompt. They read 1,500 line files, burn 100k+ tokens just scanning, lose the thread and go in circles.

2. Fixes turn into guessing games. The agent edits something, breaks a caller it never read, then spends five turns guessing how to repair it.

3. New projects get hallucinated APIs. When starting from scratch, agents invent package functions or get stuck in broken config.

Layer sits between your agent and your code and talks over the standard Model Context Protocol. Instead of raw file dumps, the agent gets symbol outlines, exact function slices, impact graphs and compile checks in milliseconds.

How it works

Layer does four main things.
1. Instant syntax checks (under 15ms)

Every edit is checked in memory using compiled Tree sitter syntax trees. Layer validates grammar, balanced brackets, strings and imports without waiting for a slow compiler to start (tsc alone takes 400 to 800ms to boot).
2. Safe multi file refactors

When an agent changes a shared interface like src/types.ts, Layer separates errors in the file you edited from errors in files that simply haven't been updated yet. Good interface edits are kept, and the agent gets a pending_downstream_updates checklist instead of a rollback.
3. Full compiler checks and an error circuit breaker

Layer plugs into your real toolchain (tsc, cargo check, pyright, go vet, clang++, dotnet, javac, mvn) and sorts every diagnostic into new, persistent or resolved. If the same error survives two or more turns, the circuit breaker steps in and feeds the agent verified type signatures and definitions so it stops guessing.
4. Task aware context

Instead of reading whole files, Layer ranks code using BM25F scoring, Personalized PageRank and test pairing. It returns small slices with exact line numbers, saving three to five wasted grep and read turns per task.
Built to scale (v1.3)

    No lock contention. Indexing runs in the background and swaps in atomically, so agent queries never wait on a big scan.
    Fast cold starts. A seed scanner capped at 250ms handles the first query on a fresh repo.
    Constant time lookups. Hash indexes replace full repo scans, so 10,000+ symbols are searched in under 40ms with a hard 450ms deadline.
    Do no harm by default. auto_rollback_on_cascade is off, so modern syntax (Python 3.12, TypeScript 5.x) never triggers a false rollback.

projects.title: doc-engine
projects.category: Featured Open Source, Vector PDF Engine
projects.description: A high performance headless document layout and vector rendering engine for React and TypeScript. Renders searchable vector PDF 1.7 streams and 60 FPS HTML5 Canvas previews without headless browsers or server daemons.
projects.fullDescription: doc-engine (@worklabs05/doc-engine) is an open source headless document layout and vector rendering engine for React and TypeScript. Unlike traditional approaches that depend on bloated headless Chromium instances (Puppeteer) or heavy Python daemons, doc-engine calculates document layout coordinates in pure TypeScript and emits native vector PDF 1.7 operators and 60 FPS Canvas previews with zero server side overhead.
features: Emits native vector PDF 1.7 paths, text operators, and shapes (no rasterization)
Natural Top Left web coordinates (0,0) automatically converted to PDF standard Bottom Left coordinates
Multi page flow with automatic pagination and synchronized headers and footers
Real time 60 FPS HTML5 Canvas preview for instantaneous in browser rendering
Zero Puppeteer, zero Chromium, and zero Python daemon dependencies
Available on npm as @worklabs05/doc-engine with comprehensive documentation

technologies.name: Core Engine
technologies.details: TypeScript, Abstract Syntax Tree (AST), Document Coordinate Matrix, PDF 1.7 Spec

technologies.details: PdfRenderer (Binary vector stream serializer), CanvasRenderer (60 FPS Canvas 2D Context)

technologies.details: Published to npm (@worklabs05/doc-engine), Vite, Rollup, ESM and CJS Dual Exports

projects.title: Tauri Core CLI
projects.description: Upstream contribution to the official Tauri desktop framework CLI (tauri init) enabling automatic prompt skipping in non interactive terminal and CI environments.
projects.fullDescription: Contributed directly to the official Tauri repository (tauri-apps/tauri) in release 2.12. Enhanced the tauri init command so that when stdin is not a terminal, the CLI automatically skips interactive prompts, preventing IO errors in continuous integration scripts and automated build environments.
features: Official upstream contribution to tauri-apps/tauri merged for Tauri 2 release
Automatic prompt skipping when stdin is not a terminal in tauri init
Eliminated requirement for passing --ci explicitly in headless environments
Prevented IO blocking and panics in automated CI test runners

projects.title: CoolPath
projects.description: Intelligent urban heat aware route planner combining FortyGuard thermal rasters, thermodynamic physiological modeling, and Gemini 2.0 to navigate pedestrians and athletes through shade rich pathways.
projects.fullDescription: CoolPath is an AI powered microclimate navigation engine designed to protect pedestrians, runners, and cyclists from extreme urban heat islands. By combining high resolution thermal rasters from FortyGuard with OpenStreetMap topology, Gemini 2.0 natural language parsing, and human thermodynamic physiological modeling, CoolPath routes travelers through shaded, microclimate cooled pathways.
features: Multi objective Pareto routing solver (Fastest vs Shaded vs Balanced thermal paths)
Sub millisecond spatial indexing using Shapely STRtree point in polygon bounding box search
Real time thermodynamic simulation of traveler core body temperature and evaporative limits
Gemini 2.0 agent parsing natural language intent into structured spatial routing queries
Automated route audio briefings generated via AWS Polly speech synthesis
Universal frontend built with Expo React Native compiling to responsive web
